name: ADCRR — Community Reentry Programs
description: The Arizona Department of Corrections, Rehabilitation and Reentry coordinates statewide community reentry planning, pre-release programming, and connections to housing, employment, and behavioral health partners for people leaving ADCRR custody. Reentry staff at the Phoenix headquarters work with facility case managers, community corrections officers, and local nonprofits across all 15 counties before and after release. This office provides planning and referrals—not emergency shelter, cash assistance, or legal representation.
description_es: El Departamento de Correcciones, Rehabilitación y Reinserción de Arizona coordina la planificación estatal de reinserción comunitaria, programación previa a la liberación y conexiones con aliados de vivienda, empleo y salud conductual para personas que salen de custodia de ADCRR. El personal de reinserción en la sede de Phoenix trabaja con administradores de casos de instalaciones, oficiales de correcciones comunitarias y organizaciones locales en los 15 condados. Esta oficina ofrece planificación y referencias, no refugio de emergencia ni asistencia en efectivo.
eligibility: Individuals in ADCRR custody preparing for release or under community supervision; community partners seeking ADCRR reentry engagement.
eligibility_es: Personas en custodia de ADCRR que se preparan para la liberación o bajo supervisión comunitaria; aliados comunitarios que buscan coordinación de reinserción.
notes: Visit corrections.az.gov/adcr/community-reentry for program overview; coordinate through facility reentry staff and assigned community corrections officer after release.
notes_es: Visite corrections.az.gov/adcr/community-reentry; coordine con el personal de reinserción de la instalación y el oficial de correcciones comunitarias asignado.
services: Pre-release planning|Community reentry coordination|Partner referrals|Reentry resource navigation|Supervision linkage

name: ADCRR — Community Corrections & Parole
description: ADCRR Community Corrections supervises adults on parole and community supervision through field offices across Arizona, connecting supervisees to employment, treatment, and housing resources as conditions of release. Community Corrections officers coordinate with ARIZONA@WORK, DES benefits, RBHA behavioral health providers, and local reentry nonprofits in every county. Contact your assigned officer—not a walk-in benefits or emergency housing intake center.
description_es: Correcciones Comunitarias de ADCRR supervisa adultos en libertad condicional y supervisión comunitaria a través de oficinas de campo en Arizona, conectando a supervisados con empleo, tratamiento y vivienda según condiciones de liberación. Los oficiales coordinan con ARIZONA@WORK, beneficios DES y proveedores RBHA en cada condado. Contacte a su oficial asignado; no es un centro de admisión de beneficios o vivienda de emergencia.
eligibility: Adults under ADCRR parole or community supervision in Arizona; report to assigned community corrections officer.
eligibility_es: Adultos bajo libertad condicional o supervisión comunitaria de ADCRR en Arizona; reporte al oficial de correcciones comunitarias asignado.
notes: Find regional field office contacts at corrections.az.gov/adcr/community-corrections; statewide information 602-542-5535.
notes_es: Encuentre contactos de oficinas regionales en corrections.az.gov/adcr/community-corrections; información estatal 602-542-5535.
hours: Field offices typically Monday–Friday business hours
services: Parole supervision|Community corrections reporting|Treatment referrals|Employment coordination|Reentry partner linkage

name: Health-e-Arizona Plus
description: Health-e-Arizona Plus is Arizona's official online portal for applying for and managing AHCCCS Medicaid, KidsCare, SNAP nutrition assistance, and cash assistance through the Department of Economic Security. Justice-involved Arizonans can apply for health coverage and food support after release from ADCRR custody or county jails using the same account used by county DES offices statewide. Online application and account management—not a crisis hotline or emergency shelter provider.
description_es: Health-e-Arizona Plus es el portal en línea oficial de Arizona para solicitar y administrar Medicaid AHCCCS, KidsCare, asistencia nutricional SNAP y asistencia en efectivo a través del Departamento de Seguridad Económica. Los arizonenses en reinserción pueden solicitar cobertura de salud y apoyo alimentario después de la liberación usando la misma cuenta que usan las oficinas DES del condado.
eligibility: Arizona residents meeting income and household requirements for Medicaid, SNAP, or TANF; criminal record generally not a barrier to Medicaid and SNAP.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Arizona que cumplan requisitos de ingresos para Medicaid, SNAP o TANF; los antecedentes penales generalmente no son barrera para Medicaid y SNAP.
notes: Apply online at healthearizonaplus.gov; call 1-855-432-7587 for DES help; statewide interview line 1-855-777-8590.
notes_es: Solicite en healthearizonaplus.gov; llame al 1-855-432-7587; línea de entrevista estatal 1-855-777-8590.
hours: Online 24/7; county DES office hours vary
services: Medicaid application|SNAP enrollment|TANF application|Benefits account management|Document upload

name: AHCCCS — Arizona Medicaid
description: The Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System administers Medicaid and KidsCare health coverage for eligible low-income Arizonans through contracted health plans and Regional Behavioral Health Authorities across all 15 counties. Returning citizens can enroll through Health-e-Arizona Plus or county DES offices to access primary care, behavioral health, and prescription coverage after release. AHCCCS is health coverage administration—not a walk-in clinic or emergency room.
description_es: El Sistema de Contención de Costos de Atención Médica de Arizona administra la cobertura Medicaid y KidsCare para arizonenses elegibles de bajos ingresos a través de planes de salud contratados y Autoridades Regionales de Salud Conductual en los 15 condados. Los ciudadanos que regresan pueden inscribirse a través de Health-e-Arizona Plus para acceder a atención primaria y salud conductual.
eligibility: Arizona residents meeting AHCCCS income and categorical eligibility; enrollment through Health-e-Arizona Plus or DES.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Arizona que cumplan elegibilidad de ingresos AHCCCS; inscripción a través de Health-e-Arizona Plus o DES.
notes: Apply at healthearizonaplus.gov; member services 602-417-4000; find your health plan at azahcccs.gov.
notes_es: Solicite en healthearizonaplus.gov; servicios al miembro 602-417-4000; encuentre su plan en azahcccs.gov.
services: Medicaid enrollment|Health plan selection|Member services|Behavioral health plan navigation|Coverage verification

name: 211 Arizona
description: 211 Arizona is a free statewide information and referral service connecting residents to health and human services including housing, food, utilities, employment, and crisis support in all 15 Arizona counties. United Way-supported navigators help callers find local programs by need and ZIP code through 211arizona.org and by dialing 211 from any Arizona phone. 211 Arizona is a referral service—not a direct-service provider.
description_es: 211 Arizona es un servicio gratuito de información y referencia estatal que conecta a residentes con servicios de salud y humanos incluyendo vivienda, alimentos, servicios públicos, empleo y apoyo en crisis en los 15 condados de Arizona. Navegadores apoyados por United Way ayudan a encontrar programas locales por necesidad y código postal.
eligibility: Open to all Arizona residents; no criminal-record restrictions stated.
eligibility_es: Abierto a todos los residentes de Arizona; sin restricciones de antecedentes indicadas.
notes: Dial 211 from any Arizona phone; search resources online at 211arizona.org; text your ZIP code to 898-211.
notes_es: Marque 211 desde cualquier teléfono de Arizona; busque recursos en 211arizona.org; envíe su código postal al 898-211.
hours: Available during published service hours; check 211arizona.org
services: Information and referral|Housing resource navigation|Benefits referrals|Crisis resource connections|Local program search

name: Community Legal Services — Statewide Intake
description: Community Legal Services is Arizona's largest nonprofit civil legal aid provider serving low-income residents with housing, public benefits, family law, and criminal record relief including set-aside petitions under Arizona law. Centralized intake at 602-258-3434 or 1-800-852-9075 routes callers to CLS offices in Phoenix, Mesa, and statewide partner sites—not criminal defense representation.
description_es: Community Legal Services es el mayor proveedor sin fines de lucro de asistencia legal civil de Arizona que sirve a residentes de bajos ingresos con vivienda, beneficios públicos, derecho familiar y alivio de antecedentes penales incluidas peticiones de anulación bajo la ley de Arizona. La admisión centralizada enruta a oficinas CLS, no defensa penal.
eligibility: Low-income Arizona residents with civil legal problems; LSC income limits apply; offense-type restrictions may apply for record relief.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Arizona de bajos ingresos con problemas legales civiles; aplican límites de ingresos LSC; pueden aplicar restricciones por tipo de delito.
notes: Apply online at clsaz.org or call 602-258-3434 / 1-800-852-9075; toll-free statewide intake routes to nearest office.
notes_es: Solicite en clsaz.org o llame al 602-258-3434 / 1-800-852-9075; admisión gratuita estatal enruta a la oficina más cercana.
hours: Intake Monday–Friday business hours; online application 24/7
services: Civil legal representation|Set-aside assistance|Housing legal aid|Benefits advocacy|Regional office referrals

name: DNA People's Legal Services
description: DNA People's Legal Services provides free civil legal aid to low-income residents across northern Arizona tribal and rural communities including Coconino, Navajo, Apache, and Mohave counties. Attorneys assist with housing, benefits, family law, and limited criminal record relief for justice-involved clients on the Colorado Plateau and tribal lands—not criminal defense.
description_es: DNA People's Legal Services brinda asistencia legal civil gratuita a residentes de bajos ingresos en comunidades tribales y rurales del norte de Arizona incluyendo los condados Coconino, Navajo, Apache y Mohave. Los abogados ayudan con vivienda, beneficios y alivio limitado de antecedentes penales, no defensa penal.
eligibility: Low-income residents of DNA service area counties and tribal communities with civil legal problems; income limits apply.
eligibility_es: Residentes de bajos ingresos del área de servicio DNA y comunidades tribales con problemas legales civiles; aplican límites de ingresos.
notes: Call 928-779-9981 for northern Arizona intake; offices also in Tuba City, Page, and Kayenta; apply at dnaazlaw.org.
notes_es: Llame al 928-779-9981 para admisión del norte de Arizona; oficinas también en Tuba City, Page y Kayenta.
services: Civil legal representation|Housing legal aid|Benefits advocacy|Tribal community services|Record relief guidance

name: ARIZONA@WORK — Statewide Network
description: ARIZONA@WORK is the statewide workforce development network operated through the Arizona Department of Economic Security, connecting job seekers in all 15 counties to career coaching, resume assistance, WIOA training referrals, and fair-chance employment navigation. Justice-involved adults leaving ADCRR custody or county jails can register at arizonaatwork.com for free core services at local one-stop centers. Workforce services—not emergency cash or housing placement.
description_es: ARIZONA@WORK es la red estatal de desarrollo de la fuerza laboral operada por el Departamento de Seguridad Económica de Arizona, conectando buscadores de empleo en los 15 condados con coaching de carrera, asistencia con currículum y referencias de capacitación WIOA. Los adultos con antecedentes penales pueden registrarse en arizonaatwork.com para servicios básicos gratuitos.
eligibility: Open to Arizona job seekers including justice-involved individuals; core ARIZONA@WORK services are free.
eligibility_es: Abierto a buscadores de empleo de Arizona incluidas personas con antecedentes penales; servicios básicos gratuitos.
notes: Register at arizonaatwork.com; find your local one-stop by ZIP code; pairs with DES benefits and RSA vocational rehabilitation.
notes_es: Regístrese en arizonaatwork.com; encuentre su centro local por código postal; se vincula con beneficios DES y rehabilitación vocacional RSA.
hours: One-stop centers typically Monday–Friday business hours
services: Career coaching|Resume assistance|WIOA training referrals|Job search tools|Fair-chance employment navigation

name: RSA — Vocational Rehabilitation Services
description: The Rehabilitation Services Administration within Arizona DES helps Arizonans with disabilities—including justice-involved individuals with documented disabilities—prepare for, obtain, and maintain employment through counseling, training, assistive technology, and job placement across all 15 counties. VR counselors coordinate with ARIZONA@WORK, AHCCCS behavioral health providers, and ADCRR reentry staff on individualized employment plans. VR eligibility requires a documented disability affecting employment—not general reentry case management.
description_es: La Administración de Servicios de Rehabilitación dentro de DES de Arizona ayuda a arizonenses con discapacidades—incluidas personas con antecedentes penales con discapacidades documentadas—a prepararse, obtener y mantener empleo a través de consejería, capacitación y colocación laboral en los 15 condados. La elegibilidad VR requiere una discapacidad documentada que afecte el empleo.
eligibility: Arizona residents with a physical or mental disability that is a substantial barrier to employment; justice-involved applicants welcome if VR eligible.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Arizona con una discapacidad física o mental que sea una barrera sustancial al empleo; solicitantes con antecedentes penales bienvenidos si son elegibles para VR.
notes: Apply at des.az.gov RSA or through local VR office; call 602-542-3332; coordinate with ARIZONA@WORK for job placement after plan approval.
notes_es: Solicite en des.az.gov RSA o en la oficina VR local; llame al 602-542-3332; coordine con ARIZONA@WORK después de aprobar el plan.
hours: State and field offices Monday–Friday business hours
services: Vocational counseling|Disability employment planning|Training referrals|Assistive technology|Job placement

name: AHCCCS — RBHA Behavioral Health Directory
description: Arizona's Regional Behavioral Health Authorities contract with AHCCCS to deliver mental health and substance use disorder services for Medicaid members and uninsured crisis populations in six regions covering all 15 counties. Justice-involved Arizonans can locate their RBHA—Mercy Care, Banner, Health Choice, Cenpatico, Arizona Complete Health, or Steward—at azahcccs.gov to access outpatient treatment, crisis services, and peer support. Directory and enrollment navigation—not a single treatment facility.
description_es: Las Autoridades Regionales de Salud Conductual de Arizona contratan con AHCCCS para ofrecer servicios de salud mental y trastornos por uso de sustancias para miembros Medicaid en seis regiones que cubren los 15 condados. Los arizonenses en reinserción pueden localizar su RBHA en azahcccs.gov para acceder a tratamiento ambulatorio, servicios de crisis y apoyo entre pares.
eligibility: AHCCCS members and crisis-eligible uninsured individuals; SUD and mental health services vary by RBHA region and plan.
eligibility_es: Miembros AHCCCS e individuos sin seguro elegibles para crisis; los servicios varían por región RBHA y plan.
notes: Find your RBHA at azahcccs.gov; crisis line 1-844-534-4673; enroll in AHCCCS through healthearizonaplus.gov first when eligible.
notes_es: Encuentre su RBHA en azahcccs.gov; línea de crisis 1-844-534-4673; inscríbase en AHCCCS a través de healthearizonaplus.gov cuando sea elegible.
hours: Crisis lines 24/7; RBHA offices business hours
services: RBHA plan navigation|Crisis behavioral health|SUD treatment referrals|Mental health services|Peer support connections

name: Arizona Department of Veterans' Services
description: The Arizona Department of Veterans' Services helps veterans and their families access federal VA benefits, state tuition waivers, employment preferences, and burial honors through benefits counselors at the Phoenix headquarters and county veterans service offices in every county. Justice-involved veterans can request benefits assistance and referrals to VA medical centers, SSVF housing providers, and ARIZONA@WORK veteran staff after release. Benefits counseling and referrals—not emergency housing or cash assistance.
description_es: El Departamento de Veteranos de Arizona ayuda a veteranos y sus familias a acceder a beneficios federales VA, exenciones de matrícula estatal y preferencias de empleo a través de consejeros en la sede de Phoenix y oficinas de servicios para veteranos del condado. Los veteranos en reinserción pueden solicitar asistencia de beneficios y referencias a centros médicos VA.
eligibility: Arizona veterans, service members, and eligible family members; discharge status and benefit type determine services.
eligibility_es: Veteranos de Arizona, miembros del servicio y familiares elegibles; el estado de baja y tipo de beneficio determinan los servicios.
notes: Visit dvs.az.gov; call 602-542-8811; find your county veterans service officer through the DVS locator.
notes_es: Visite dvs.az.gov; llame al 602-542-8811; encuentre su oficial de servicios para veteranos del condado en el localizador DVS.
hours: State office Monday–Friday business hours; CVSO hours vary by county
services: VA benefits counseling|Disability claims assistance|Employment preference guidance|Tuition waiver information|County CVSO referrals

name: Arizona MVD — azmvdnow.gov
description: The Arizona Motor Vehicle Division issues state ID cards and driver's licenses through azmvdnow.gov and MVD offices statewide, a critical step for justice-involved Arizonans reestablishing identification after release. Many MVD services including ID card renewal and address changes can be completed online; first-time IDs and reinstatements may require an office visit with proof of identity and residency. MVD issues credentials—not legal name change or birth certificate services.
description_es: La División de Vehículos Motorizados de Arizona emite tarjetas de identificación estatal y licencias de conducir a través de azmvdnow.gov y oficinas MVD en todo el estado, un paso crítico para arizonenses en reinserción que restablecen identificación después de la liberación. Muchos servicios MVD pueden completarse en línea; las identificaciones por primera vez pueden requerir visita a oficina.
eligibility: Arizona residents seeking state ID or driver's license; specific documents required for first issuance after incarceration.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Arizona que buscan identificación estatal o licencia de conducir; se requieren documentos específicos para primera emisión después de encarcelación.
notes: Start at azmvdnow.gov; call 602-255-0072; bring certified birth certificate or passport plus two proofs of Arizona residency.
notes_es: Comience en azmvdnow.gov; llame al 602-255-0072; traiga acta de nacimiento certificada o pasaporte más dos comprobantes de residencia en Arizona.
hours: Online 24/7; office hours vary by location
services: State ID issuance|Driver license services|Online credential renewal|Reinstatement guidance|Third-party office locator

name: ADHS — Office of Vital Records
description: The Arizona Department of Health Services Office of Vital Records issues certified birth and death certificates needed for state ID, employment, and benefits applications across Arizona. Returning citizens who lack identity documents can order certified copies online, by mail, or in person at the Phoenix office with acceptable identification or qualified applicant rules. Vital records issuance—not a legal aid or MVD licensing office.
description_es: La Oficina de Registros Vitales del Departamento de Servicios de Salud de Arizona emite actas de nacimiento y defunción certificadas necesarias para identificación estatal, empleo y solicitudes de beneficios. Los ciudadanos que regresan sin documentos de identidad pueden solicitar copias certificadas en línea, por correo o en persona en la oficina de Phoenix.
eligibility: Individuals with legal right to request vital records per Arizona law; qualified applicants may order for others with documentation.
eligibility_es: Personas con derecho legal a solicitar registros vitales según la ley de Arizona; solicitantes calificados pueden pedir para otros con documentación.
notes: Order online at azdhs.gov vital records; call 602-364-1300; first-time requests may take 2–3 weeks by mail.
notes_es: Solicite en línea en azdhs.gov registros vitales; llame al 602-364-1300; las primeras solicitudes pueden tardar 2–3 semanas por correo.
hours: Office Monday–Friday business hours; online ordering 24/7
services: Certified birth certificates|Death certificate issuance|Online vital records orders|Identity document support|Records verification

name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
description: The 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline provides free, confidential 24/7 support for people in mental health, substance use, or suicidal crisis across Arizona, routing to local crisis centers and mobile teams when needed. Justice-involved individuals and families can call or text 988 for immediate emotional support and connections to RBHA crisis services—not ongoing case management or housing placement.
description_es: La Línea de Crisis y Prevención del Suicidio 988 ofrece apoyo gratuito y confidencial 24/7 para personas en crisis de salud mental, uso de sustancias o suicidio en Arizona, enrutando a centros de crisis locales cuando sea necesario. Las personas con antecedentes penales y familias pueden llamar o enviar mensaje al 988 para apoyo emocional inmediato.
eligibility: Anyone in mental health or suicidal crisis in the United States; Spanish-language support available.
eligibility_es: Cualquier persona en crisis de salud mental o suicida en los Estados Unidos; apoyo en español disponible.
notes: Call or text 988; chat at 988lifeline.org; veterans press 1; pairs with Arizona RBHA crisis line 1-844-534-4673.
notes_es: Llame o envíe mensaje al 988; chat en 988lifeline.org; veteranos presionen 1; se vincula con línea de crisis RBHA 1-844-534-4673.
services: Crisis counseling|Suicide prevention|Substance use crisis support|Local crisis center referral|Spanish-language support

name: SAMHSA National Helpline
description: The SAMHSA National Helpline at 1-800-662-4357 is a free, confidential, 24/7 treatment referral service connecting callers to local substance use and mental health providers across Arizona and nationwide. Returning citizens and families can receive referrals to RBHA-contracted treatment, MAT providers, and peer support programs by ZIP code. Referral and information only—not a treatment facility or emergency housing provider.
description_es: La Línea Nacional de Ayuda de SAMHSA al 1-800-662-4357 es un servicio gratuito, confidencial y 24/7 de referencia a tratamiento que conecta a personas con proveedores locales de uso de sustancias y salud mental en Arizona y a nivel nacional. Solo referencia e información, no un centro de tratamiento.
eligibility: Open to anyone seeking substance use or mental health treatment information and referrals; no insurance required to call.
eligibility_es: Abierto a cualquier persona que busque información y referencias de tratamiento de uso de sustancias o salud mental; no se requiere seguro para llamar.
notes: Call 1-800-662-4357; TTY 1-800-487-4889; also search findtreatment.gov by Arizona ZIP code.
notes_es: Llame al 1-800-662-4357; TTY 1-800-487-4889; también busque en findtreatment.gov por código postal de Arizona.
services: Treatment referrals|Provider locator|Mental health resource navigation|Spanish-language helpline|MAT provider information

name: FindTreatment.gov — Arizona Locator
description: FindTreatment.gov is SAMHSA's searchable directory of licensed substance use and mental health treatment facilities, including outpatient, residential, and medication-assisted treatment providers across all Arizona counties. Justice-involved adults, probation officers, and reentry navigators can filter by payment options including Medicaid and justice-involved programs. Online locator only—not a crisis line or direct admission service.
description_es: FindTreatment.gov es el directorio buscable de SAMHSA de centros de tratamiento licenciados de uso de sustancias y salud mental, incluidos proveedores ambulatorios, residenciales y de tratamiento asistido con medicamentos en todos los condados de Arizona. Solo localizador en línea, no línea de crisis.
eligibility: Open to anyone seeking treatment facility information; filter by Arizona location, services, and payment type.
eligibility_es: Abierto a cualquier persona que busque información de centros de tratamiento; filtre por ubicación en Arizona, servicios y tipo de pago.
notes: Search findtreatment.gov by Arizona city or ZIP; call SAMHSA helpline 1-800-662-4357 for navigator help.
notes_es: Busque en findtreatment.gov por ciudad o código postal de Arizona; llame a la línea SAMHSA 1-800-662-4357.
services: Treatment facility search|MAT provider locator|Payment filter tools|Outpatient and residential listings|Justice-involved program filter

name: Arizona Justice Project
description: The Arizona Justice Project is a nonprofit law clinic that investigates claims of wrongful conviction and assists with post-conviction relief, DNA testing motions, and limited reentry legal support for incarcerated and formerly incarcerated Arizonans. Staff and law school volunteers review cases meeting project criteria—not a general legal aid office for eviction, benefits, or routine expungement.
description_es: El Arizona Justice Project es una clínica legal sin fines de lucro que investiga reclamos de condena injusta y ayuda con alivio post-condena, mociones de pruebas de ADN y apoyo legal limitado de reinserción para arizonenses encarcelados y anteriormente encarcelados. No es una oficina general de ayuda legal para desalojo o beneficios.
eligibility: Cases meeting Arizona Justice Project intake criteria for wrongful conviction or post-conviction claims; limited capacity.
eligibility_es: Casos que cumplan criterios de admisión del Arizona Justice Project para condena injusta o reclamos post-condena; capacidad limitada.
notes: Apply through azjusticeproject.org case inquiry form; call 602-262-7144; does not replace CLS for general civil legal aid.
notes_es: Solicite a través del formulario de consulta en azjusticeproject.org; llame al 602-262-7144; no reemplaza a CLS para ayuda legal civil general.
services: Post-conviction investigation|DNA testing motions|Wrongful conviction review|Limited reentry legal support|Law student clinic

name: DES — SNAP Employment & Training (CAN)
description: Arizona's Connecting Arizona to Next Employment (CAN) program through DES provides SNAP Employment & Training services including job search coaching, skills training referrals, and support services for SNAP recipients statewide including justice-involved adults meeting program rules. Participants work with DES contractors and ARIZONA@WORK partners to satisfy SNAP work requirements and build employment history. E&T program—not standalone cash assistance.
description_es: El programa Connecting Arizona to Next Employment (CAN) a través de DES ofrece servicios de Empleo y Capacitación SNAP incluyendo coaching de búsqueda de empleo y referencias de capacitación para beneficiarios SNAP en todo el estado incluidos adultos con antecedentes penales que cumplan las reglas del programa.
eligibility: Arizona SNAP recipients referred to or enrolled in DES Employment & Training; work requirement rules apply.
eligibility_es: Beneficiarios SNAP de Arizona referidos o inscritos en Empleo y Capacitación DES; aplican reglas de requisitos de trabajo.
notes: Enroll through county DES office or ARIZONA@WORK referral; call 1-855-432-7587; pairs with healthearizonaplus.gov SNAP account.
notes_es: Inscríbase a través de la oficina DES del condado o referencia ARIZONA@WORK; llame al 1-855-432-7587.
hours: Program hours vary by contractor and county
services: SNAP Employment & Training|Job search coaching|Skills training referrals|Work requirement support|ARIZONA@WORK linkage

name: ADCRR — Community Reentry Center Overview
description: ADCRR Community Reentry Centers provide structured transitional programming at select facilities and community sites, combining employment readiness, cognitive programming, substance use education, and community partner linkages before release to parole or community supervision. The statewide reentry center model coordinates with ARIZONA@WORK, DES, and local housing providers—not a standalone halfway house open to walk-in public intake.
description_es: Los Centros de Reinserción Comunitaria de ADCRR ofrecen programación transicional estructurada en instalaciones seleccionadas y sitios comunitarios, combinando preparación laboral, programación cognitiva, educación sobre uso de sustancias y vínculos con aliados comunitarios antes de la liberación a libertad condicional. No es una casa de transición abierta al público.
eligibility: ADCRR inmates assigned to community reentry center programming per classification and release plan; community walk-in not available.
eligibility_es: Personas en custodia de ADCRR asignadas a programación del centro de reinserción comunitaria según clasificación y plan de liberación; no hay admisión comunitaria sin cita.
notes: Programming accessed through ADCRR classification and facility reentry staff; public overview at corrections.az.gov/adcr/community-reentry.
notes_es: La programación se accede a través de clasificación ADCRR y personal de reinserción de la instalación; descripción pública en corrections.az.gov.
services: Transitional programming|Employment readiness|Cognitive programming|Community partner linkage|Pre-release coordination

name: DES — Benefits Information Line
description: The Arizona Department of Economic Security Benefits Information Line connects residents to SNAP, AHCCCS Medicaid, TANF cash assistance, and child care subsidy programs administered through county DES offices in all 15 counties. Returning citizens can call for application status, interview scheduling, and document guidance before visiting their county office in person. Phone and referral support—not a walk-in office.
description_es: La Línea de Información de Beneficios del Departamento de Seguridad Económica de Arizona conecta a residentes con programas SNAP, Medicaid AHCCCS, asistencia en efectivo TANF y subsidios de cuidado infantil administrados a través de oficinas DES del condado en los 15 condados. Apoyo telefónico y de referencia, no una oficina presencial.
eligibility: Arizona residents applying for or receiving DES benefits; criminal record generally not a barrier to SNAP and Medicaid.
eligibility_es: Residentes de Arizona que solicitan o reciben beneficios DES; los antecedentes penales generalmente no son barrera para SNAP y Medicaid.
notes: Call 1-855-432-7587; apply online at healthearizonaplus.gov; find county office at des.az.gov/find-your-local-office.
notes_es: Llame al 1-855-432-7587; solicite en healthearizonaplus.gov; encuentre oficina del condado en des.az.gov.
services: Benefits information|Application status|Interview scheduling|County office referrals|Document guidance

name: UMOM New Day Centers
